description_en: Queries the inventory of instance types or system disk types in a zone before you change the instance type or system disk type of an instance
description_zh: 变更实例规格或系统盘类型之前，查询某一可用区下实例规格或系统盘的库存情况
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-resources-modification --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --destination-resource InstanceType --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourcesModification

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance whose specification or system disk type you want to change. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 待变更实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance whose instance type or system disk type you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 待变更规格或系统盘类型的实例ID（InstanceId）
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cross-cluster upgrade or downgrade of instance types is supported. Valid values: 
        
true: Supported.
false: Not supported.

Default value: false.

If the MigrateAcrossZone parameter is set to true and you upgrade or downgrade the Elastic Compute Service instance based on the returned information, take note of the following items: 
            
VPC-type instances: For https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55263.html, when a non-I/O optimized instance is changed to an I/O optimized instance, the disk device names and software authorization codes of the server are changed. For Linux instances, basic disks (cloud) are identified as xvda or xvdb, and ultra disks (cloud_efficiency) and standard SSDs (cloud_ssd) are identified as vda or vdb
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持跨集群升级实例规格。取值范围： 
        
true：支持。
false：不支持。

默认值：false。

当参数MigrateAcrossZone取值为true时，一旦您根据返回信息升级了云服务器，请留意以下注意事项： 
            
专有网络VPC类型实例：对于https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55263.html，非I/O优化实例变配到I/O优化实例时，云服务器云盘设备名和软件授权码会发生变化。Linux实例的普通云盘（cloud）会被识别为xvda或者xvdb等，高效云盘（cloud_efficiency）和SSD云盘（cloud_ssd）会被识别为vda或者vdb等
parameters.name: migrate_across_zone

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource that you want to change. Valid values: 
         
InstanceType: instance type.
SystemDisk: system disk type.

  If you set this parameter to SystemDisk, you must also specify the InstanceType parameter to indicate the disk type required by the target instance type
parameters.help_zh:
待变更的实例资源类型。取值范围： 
         
InstanceType：实例规格。
SystemDisk：系统盘类型。

  取值为SystemDisk时，必须同时指定InstanceType参数。表示目标规格要求的云盘类型
parameters.name: destination_resource

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Upgrade/Downgrade operation.

Valid values for subscription resources: 

    - Upgrade: upgrades resources.
    - Downgrade: downgrades resources.
    - RenewDowngrade: downgrades resources upon renewal.
    - RenewModify: renewal with specification change for an expired instance.

Valid value for pay-as-you-go resources: Upgrade.

Default value: Upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
更改资源配置的操作类型。

包年包月资源的取值范围： 

    - Upgrade：升级资源。
    - Downgrade：降级资源。
    - RenewDowngrade：续费降配。
    - RenewModify：过期实例的续费变配。

按量付费资源的取值：Upgrade。

默认值：Upgrade
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The target instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html. You can also invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html to query the most recent instance type list.

If DestinationResource is set to SystemDisk, you must also specify the InstanceType parameter to indicate the disk type required by the target instance type
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例规格。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html，也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html 接口获得最新的规格表。

当参数DestinationResource取值为SystemDisk时，必须同时指定InstanceType参数。表示目标规格要求的云盘类型
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of vCPU kernel of the target instance type. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html.

This parameter takes effect only when DestinationResource is set to InstanceType
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例规格的vCPU内核数目。取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。

仅当DestinationResource=InstanceType参数有效，Cores为有效参数
parameters.name: cores

parameters.help_en:
The memory size of the target instance type. Unit: GiB. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html.

This parameter takes effect only when DestinationResource is set to InstanceType
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例规格的内存大小，单位为GiB。取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。

仅当DestinationResource=InstanceType，Memory才为有效参数
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target zone.

Specify this parameter when you want to change the instance type across zones
parameters.help_zh:
目标可用区ID。

当需要跨可用区变更实例规格时，需要指定该参数
parameters.name: zone_id
